text:
nina: FYI CI scans started erroring after yesterday's KMS key rotation. Error is kms:DecryptAccessDenied when scanner tries to pull evidence blobs.

scanner-bot: [ALERT] sast+dast pipeline failed 1768801234 - decrypt error in evidence fetch step. job: `scan-runner`.

rachel: Can someone paste the error lines? Need to confirm whether it's a grant or bucket policy problem.

nina: Logs: ```ERROR: failed to decrypt s3://sec-evidence/2026/03/22/scan-9012.enc: kms:DecryptAccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333:key/rot-2026-03-22
stack: scanner/service/kms_client.go:110```

marco: Sounds like our rotation updated alias and secret but we didn't create an aws_kms_grant for role `svc-scan-runner`. Rotation script is missing the grant step.

infra-oncall: Rolling alias back to previous key to restore CI while we patch rotation. Doing now.

rachel: Short-term mitigation ok. Long-term we need: 1) post-rotation smoke test that assumes the scanner role and runs `aws kms decrypt`, 2) terraform PR template guard to ensure `aws_kms_grant` or `aws_kms_key_policy` updates included, 3) alert metric `scan.evidence.decrypt.failures` routed to sec-oncall.

scanner-bot: Suggested smoke test snippet for rotation job:
```
# assume scanner role
creds=$(aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333:role/svc-scan-runner --role-session-name smoke-test)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --key-id $SAST_KEY_ARN
```

marco: I'll update rotation script to create grant after key creation: `aws kms create-grant --key-id $SAST_KEY_ARN --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::333:role/svc-scan-runner --operations Decrypt` and add retry/wait loop for grant propagation. Also add smoke GH action.

nina: I'll own alerting. Plan to create Prometheus rule: `sum by(job)(increase(scan_evidence_decrypt_failures[1m])) > 0` -> page sec-oncall.

rachel: I'll add a PR checklist item for rotation changes: include grant, smoke test, terraform plan shows aws_kms_grant changes, and add evidence inventory run to check for objects re-wrapped with new key.

infra-oncall: CI green after alias revert. Posting incident note to #incidents and opening follow-up ticket.

marco: Will open PR to rotation repo with grant + smoke action. ETA end of day.

nina: Great. Close after PR merges and alert wired. :white_check_mark:
